spoken_first_2s: നിങ്ങൾ ഷാർജയിലോ ദുബായിലോ അജ്മാനിലോ ഉള്ളവരാണെങ്കിൽ എന്തായാലും നിങ്ങൾക്ക്

notes.hook: 'If you're in Sharjah, Dubai or Ajman, this video is useful for you, don't skip'
notes.what_goes_wrong: A 'useful video, don't skip' opener, a vague 'great price' with no number, and two CTAs at the end (follow and save): an ad, not a reel.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: 'useful video, don't skip' openers and 'great price' with no number; show the cracked screen and say the price.
